WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON s.trdref2 = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_anlycount
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    pa.transref,
    pa.tradekind,
    pa.avg_anlycount,
    pa.avg_anlycount - om.mean_anlycount AS amount_above_mean
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pa.avg_anlycount > om.mean_anlycount
),
trader_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    fp.tradekind,
    AVG(fp.avg_anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(fp.amount_above_mean) AS avg_amount_above_mean
  FROM filtered_pairs fp
  GROUP BY fp.tradekind
),
analyst_count_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_analyst_count
  FROM trader_type_stats
)
SELECT
  tts.tradekind,
  tts.avg_analyst_count,
  tts.avg_amount_above_mean,
  tts.avg_analyst_count / acm.mean_analyst_count AS ratio
FROM trader_type_stats tts
CROSS JOIN analyst_count_mean acm
ORDER BY tts.tradekind;
